decisions.reason: The low-pile decorative carpet sits close to the firm's established textile and material know-how and still has its own page in 2024, so the firm can read its results and keep refining it, although carpet collections rotate and a sister design (C) was already removed.
The hand-knotted wool silk carpet draws directly on the firm's craftsmanship and fine-materials expertise and remains prominently presented, so it fits the knowledge base the firm can build on.

The Ison corner bench extends the firm's seating and table competence and is still promoted as a new interpretation, so management can assimilate early feedback and develop it, even though it moved from its own page to a mention.
The low-pile carpet closely matches existing material skills and keeps its own page, so it is likely retained despite some risk of portfolio rotation among similar carpets.
The swivel shell chair is core upholstered seating built on long designer collaborations and in-house expertise, and it remains fully presented, so it is a stable addition to the range.
